title: A2A skill manifest
description: Declarative definition of one A2A skill. Each YAML file under srv/a2a/skills/ is validated against this schema. The same file drives (a) the Agent Card skills[] entry Copilot Studio sees and (b) the deterministic OData call the executor makes. Add a skill = add a file; change a description = edit one line.

id.description: Unique, kebab-case skill id. Surfaced in the Agent Card and used by clients to select the skill.

description.description: Rich, specific description. This is the ONLY guidance the Copilot Studio LLM gets to pick this skill and extract parameters, so be precise about what it returns and when to use it.

domain.description: Informational grouping (e.g. sales, procurement, finance, master-data). Not sent to the client.

examples.description: Example natural-language prompts this skill handles (Agent Card).

outputModes.description: Output MIME types for this skill, overriding the card default. Defaults to application/json.

params.description: Parameter contract. Single source of truth for runtime validation and normalization. key/filter/top entries reference these by name.

type.description: date = YYYY-MM-DD (executor formats as OData V2 datetime literal).

pad.description: Left-pad the (string) value with zeros to this width before use, e.g. SAP 10-char BP / account numbers.

service.description: OData V2 service technical name. Base path becomes /sap/opu/odata/sap/<service>.

operation.description: getByKey = read one document by its key. list = read a filtered, $top-capped collection.

key.description: For getByKey: the key fields. One entry = unnamed key A_Set('x'); several = named composite A_Set(F1='x',F2='y').

field.description: OData property name of the key.

param.description: Name of the param supplying its value.

filter.description: For list: $filter conditions. Optional-param conditions are only applied when the param is provided. Multiple entries are AND-ed.

select.description: $select field list. Always narrow the read.

expand.description: $expand navigation properties. `when` makes an expand conditional on a boolean param.

when.description: Name of a boolean param; expand added only when truthy.

orderby.description: $orderby clause as an ordered list of sort keys.

param.description: Optional param that overrides the default page size.
